title: projects.board.task.updated
description: A card was edited or moved. Every field is the card's state after the change. `completed_at` is set when the card enters `done` and cleared when it leaves.
$comment: Ahead of the producer (ADR-0020 slice I6): services/projects/app/services.py:update_task does not emit title, assignee_id, priority, due_date, points, completed_at yet. Until that slice merges, a real payload fails this schema on exactly those fields. That is the forcing function, not a bug. Every other field is emitted today.
